thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx error rate detected in eu-west-1 across streaming/embeddings endpoints. Current 5xx ~72% on load-balanced frontends. Paging @raj (oncall) and @maria (sre).

raj (oncall): ack, on it. Triage started. Can you confirm which provider/pools are affected?

maria (sre): jumping in. Early looks: provider-A edge nodes in eu-west-1 showing intermittent packet loss and TLS handshake timeouts. Backend GPUs fine.

raj (oncall): confirmed — cross-checking route tables and recent deploys. No deploys in the last 30m. Network flaps correlate with provider-A egress to our frontends.

ops-bot: Auto-fallback policy triggered: provider-B receiving 12% of traffic for eu-west-1 as of 1772003478.

raj (oncall): good. I'm going to initiate a targeted provider reroute for eu-west-1 to shift ~80% traffic off provider-A. Will also apply temporary rate limits for streaming to reduce pressure.

sophie (infra): recommend partial brownout: disable non-critical streaming features (realtime-logs, debug-traces) and reduce streaming chunk size to lower tail latency while reroute finishes.

raj (oncall): executing reroute. Command run: `/infra reroute --region eu-west-1 --from provider-A --to provider-B --percent 80 --dry=false`

ops-bot: Reroute job initiated (job_id=reroute-1772003489). Estimated completion 90s.

maria (sre): setting conservative per-key concurrent stream cap for eu-west-1 to avoid noisy neighbors. Patch snippet applied via control plane:
```
PATCH /v1/admin/limits
{
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "concurrent_streams_per_key": 2,
  "reason": "mitigation - provider instability"
}
```

eng-lead: quick customer-impact note: top 10 customers in eu-west-1 saw elevated latency/timeouts; some retries have started. Ops, please prioritize any paying customers with active incidents.

raj (oncall): also throttling sandbox and trial tiers in region to 50r/min to preserve capacity for paid traffic. Command: `/admin/quota throttle --region eu-west-1 --tier sandbox --rate 50`

incident-bot: Reroute job completed (job_id=reroute-1772003489) at 1772003600. provider-B now handling ~82% of eu-west-1 traffic.

sophie (infra): monitoring now — provider-B paths look stable, but a few edge hosts show elevated retransmits; brownout in effect: `feature:disable realtime-logs eu-west-1`, `streaming.chunk_size=256` applied.

maria (sre): metrics update: 5xx dropped from 72% -> 9% within 4 minutes after reroute + rate limits, p50/p95 latencies improving. Still seeing retries from a subset of clients.

eng-lead: support notified and we posted a status update to customers. Please include mitigations and ETA.

raj (oncall): initiating customer-facing message draft for status.redwood.ai and support. Notifying top impacted customers directly.

ops-bot: Canary traffic steady. Error rate now 3.8% on canary subset. Scaling and routing policies holding.

raj (oncall): handing off active monitoring to @sophie for the night shift. Handoff notes: reroute job id, limits applied, brownout features disabled, follow-up actions: escalate to provider contacts if provider-B shows >10% packet loss or if errors creep back up. Handoff timestamp: 1772005000.

sophie (infra): ack, taking over. I'll keep 15m checks and escalate if SLOs degrade. If things are stable for 60m, we can consider rolling back brownout and restoring normal quotas.

maria (sre): assigning postmortem to raj + maria. Initial severity: sev2. Please capture timeline and decision log for reroute, rate limits, and brownout toggles.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, handlers=[raj,maria], oncall_handoff=1772005000. Postmortem assigned. :white_check_mark:

raj (oncall): closing active paging loop. Thanks team — great coordination.

sophie (infra): will update if any regression.
